samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_div">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency of 100MHz signal into three different clock frequencies: 50MHz, 10MHz, and 1MHz.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="CLK_in">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal.</input>
        <output id="CLK_50">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 2.</output>
        <output id="CLK_10">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 10.</output>
        <output id="CLK_1">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 100.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Three counters are used to divide the input clock frequency. CLK_50 is generated by toggling the value of CLK_50 on every positive edge of CLK_in or RST. CLK_10 is generated by toggling the value of CLK_10 on every positive edge of CLK_in or RST based on the value of cnt_10. CLK_1 is generated by toggling the value of CLK_1 on every positive edge of CLK_in or RST based on the value of cnt_100.</implementation>
</module>
